title: THE FALLING BALL  example storyboard  (placeholder frames, 9:16)
notes: Screen direction: rain and the ball's fall go down-right; the character looks and walks LEFT to the ball, then carries it RIGHT, back to the door. Match on action 3 -> 4: the ball exits the bottom at the right third and enters the top at the right third.

shots.cut_in: fade up from black on the storm
shots.camera: slow push-in to the house (end frame shown)
shots.action: Storm wide. Rain slants down-right, the direction the story will travel. A lightning flash is the cut.

shots.camera: tilt UP from the roofline to the sky; ends on the lightning (upper-right third)
shots.action: Where is the storm coming from? The tilt answers the push-in.

shots.cut_in: cut as the tilt settles: the ball enters frame TOP
shots.camera: tilt DOWN with the fall, then lock
shots.action: The ball falls down-right and EXITS the bottom at the right third.

shots.cut_in: MATCH ON ACTION: the ball enters TOP at the right third, same speed
shots.action: Plop: squash, bounce, splash (the impact on ones).

shots.cut_in: door-creak sound bridge; cut as the door swings open
shots.camera: LOCKED (warm light spills over the cold blue)
shots.action: The character steps out; eyeline LEFT to the ball (lead room on the left).

shots.cut_in: cut on the step left: the character arrives at the puddle
shots.camera: slow push-in (end frame puts the face on the upper-left third)
shots.action: Picks up the ball, turns and heads RIGHT, back toward the door.
